judge.reason: The answer maps each adopted DoD item against actual enforcement (CI is build and unit tests only; there is no scanner, no docs checkbox, and staging is manual) and pairs each gap with a concrete remedy. Those remedies are a scanner failing on high/critical findings, lint as a required check, branch protection, automated staging plus a smoke test, and integration tests later. It explicitly notes a PR checkbox is still self-attested, unlike required enforcement. It does not silently drop items: relaxing the DoD is presented as an explicit owner decision with a record of which items are tooling-enforced versus by convention, though it could have said more firmly that the change needs authorized sign-off.
